lines: In a world packed like nuts in a bag
Everyone leans on the person they met
We, who slipped in, are like peanuts
Pretending to be nuts, we wear a smile
On the template of happiness
Literally the painted surface behind the picture
Even when we gather around the table and clasp hands
We cannot stay just as we are
A home full of secrets and patches, you know?
Even if we chew it up, it doesn’t disappear
Our true feelings still stay stuck between teeth
A life full of anxiety, left to chance, and I know
It’s a daily life covered in pretenses
Here I am, and you are here
Just this truth makes my stomach swell
Like a single peeled peanut skin
When society instantly casts you out, that’s precisely the moment
If it’s okay to be crooked, let me stay by your side
We’ll be roasted together, shaken, even trampled
Because we’ll become an unbreakable shell
Whether we were born on a tree or in the ground
That’s the only difference
In this unbearably dry world
May the rain moisten it equally
Beyond the cold, noisy window, you know?
Not a single star can be found
It’s fine to have a day full of thunder
A show full of mistakes and improvisation, but I know
After all, it’s just a day of being a single person
Let’s pour it into our guts and sleep
A home full of secrets and patches, you know?
While devouring everything without leaving any special or ready-made
There is no normal, no right answer, life, and I know
It’s a daily life covered in pretenses
Here I am, and you are here
Just this truth makes my stomach swell, whoa
We’ll savor this handful of miracle
